content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment infrastructure in Ghana is fragmented and unreliable. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often restrict transactions, leaving creators unable to receive payments from international buyers. But Coremerch's infrastructure bypasses these limitations, using blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare's global network to facilitate secure and fast transactions. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can set up your payment pipeline, you need a few essential tools. First, you'll need a domain name and a GitHub Pages account for hosting. Then, you'll need a Cloudflare account for SSL encryption and security. Finally, you'll need a NOWPayments account for automatic crypto verification. With these tools in place, you can start building your digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment pipeline, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and link it to your Cloudflare account. Then, you'll need to configure your payment settings, including the currencies you accept and the fees you charge. Next, you'll need to set up your delivery pipeline, using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering your digital products. With your payment and delivery pipeline in place, you can start accepting payments and delivering your digital products to your customers.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and start processing transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment and trigger the delivery of your digital product. You can track your transactions and customer activity using the NOWPayments dashboard.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. With Coremerch's infrastructure, you can easily add new payment options, increase your storage capacity, and improve your security and performance. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your business continues to run smoothly and securely, even as you grow and expand your customer base.
